ott.bulb.tip1: Flips its state when receiving a redstone signal.
ott.bulb.tip2: Use glowstone dust on it to turn it to full brightness and a redstone torch to turn it on and off by hand.
ott.configuration.harvest.allowemptyhand: Allow harvesting with empty hand. If disabled, requires hoe.
ott.configuration.harvest.allowfakeplaye: Allow machines, like Create's deployer, to harvest crops.
ott.configuration.harvest.blacklistcrops: List of crops to blacklist from right-click harvest. Format: "modid:block"
ott.configuration.harvest.blacklistheldi: List of held items to blacklist from right-click harvest. Format: "modid:item"
ott.configuration.harvest.blacklistmods: List of mods to blacklist from right-click harvest. Format: "modid"
ott.configuration.harvest.expandhoerange: Expand hoe range based on tier.
Expand hoe range by 1 for each level of efficiency enchantment level.
ott.configuration.harvest.harvestableblo:
Blocks that right clicking should simulate click instead of breaking.
For blocks like berry bushes that have built-in right click harvest.
ott.configuration.harvest.harvestablecro:
Harvestable crops.
Format: "harvestState[,afterHarvest]", i.e. "minecraft:wheat[age=7]"
or "minecraft:cocoa[age=2,facing=north],minecraft:cocoa[age=0,facing=north]"
WARNING: If autoConfigMods is set to false, only crops defined here will work.
If not, it will just add to the auto-configured list.
ott.configuration.harvest.hightierexpans: Regular hoe (gold, wood, iron) expansion range.
ott.configuration.harvest.hoeitems:
List of individual hoe tools and their harvest tier. This is for modded items not covered.
Format: minecraft:wooden_hoe-0 (with number being tier)
ott.configuration.harvest.maxhoeexpansio:
Maximum range hoe can expand for harvesting.
This is the maximum of tier + efficiency enchantment.
ott.configuration.harvest.safeharvest: Prevents immature crops from being broken.
ott.configuration.harvest.smalltierexpan: Regular hoe (gold, wood, iron) expansion range.
ott.configuration.harvest.xpfromharvesta: Amount of XP dropped on harvest.
ott.configuration.harvest.xpfromharvestc: Chance of XP dropping on harvest.
ott.configuration.harvest.xpfromharvestr: Range of XP dropped on harvest. Format: "min-max", example: "0-3"
ott.configuration.harvest.xpfromharvestu: Use range for XP drop, instead of set amount.
ott.item.name_tag.description: Use %s + %s to set a new name without an anvil.
